source.declared_methodology: Daily flow is computed as the change in each fund's issuer-reported XRP holdings versus the prior trading day. USD flow multiplies XRP flow by that day's XRP reference price. This is a holdings-delta estimate, not a direct issuer-reported creations/redemptions feed.
source.license_note: Free to use and cite with attribution; commercial redistribution requires written permission.

coverage.row_unit: one row per fund per trading day
coverage.provisional_resettlement: Latest trading-day row is rebuilt after issuer NAV/holdings publication; source metadata states next-morning re-settlement at 10:00 and 13:00 UTC, with Friday rows at Saturday 12:30 UTC.

funds.note: Source says part of reported XRP exposure is held through another XRP exchange-traded product; avoid double-counting fund-of-fund exposure as incremental underlying XRP.
Flow series withheld for 2026-09-02 through 2026-09-28 because issuer page blocked automated reads; holdings remain in AUM totals and catch-up was recorded on 2026-09-28.
Only XRP sleeve is counted; XRP holdings can change due to index rebalancing, so holdings deltas are not necessarily creations/redemptions.

quality_findings.finding: The source metadata says data_as_of is 2026-10-30 while latest_row_date is 2026-11-02 and the November 2 row is provisional.
quality_findings.implication: Do not use November 2 as a settled ETF-flow observation. At capture time the latest settled row was October 30.

quality_findings.finding: Flows are calculated from holdings deltas rather than obtained from issuer flow reports.
quality_findings.implication: Changes caused by factors other than creations/redemptions, including index rebalancing and fee accruals paid in XRP, can be counted as flow.

quality_findings.finding: The source identifies reconstructed rows for 2026-03-23 through 2026-03-27, 2026-03-31 through 2026-04-29, and 2026-05-12, where holdings were rebuilt from third-party daily flow estimates between issuer-reported anchor days.
quality_findings.implication: These rows must carry reconstructed status and must not be treated as direct issuer snapshots.

quality_findings.finding: GXRP flows are withheld across the full history; holdings and AUM remain included.
quality_findings.implication: Aggregate flow totals that include all holdings/AUM do not necessarily have complete fund-level flow coverage.

quality_findings.finding: XRPR may hold part of its XRP exposure through another XRP ETP.
quality_findings.implication: Do not add the full reported XRPR exposure to underlying issuer-held XRP without decomposing look-through holdings.

quality_findings.finding: The latest row may be rewritten during next-morning settlement as issuers publish NAV and holdings.
quality_findings.implication: Store the provisional version immutably, then append a separately timestamped settled revision; never overwrite the earlier observation.

source_independence.holdings_origin: Issuer websites are declared as the primary origin for holdings values.
source_independence.flow_origin: XRP Insights computes the flow series from those holdings; the computed flow is not an independent second source.
source_independence.corroboration_requirement: For critical fund-level flows, reconcile the issuer's dated holdings/NAV snapshot with at least one independent provider or the fund's official basket/creation-redemption disclosure. Preserve disagreements.

model_controls: Use only settled rows for primary ETF-flow features; expose provisional rows in a separate feature namespace.
Keep XRP-denominated holdings delta, USD-valued delta, fund AUM, share volume and share price as separate fields.
Mark reconstructed and excluded observations explicitly; do not forward-fill missing flow as zero.
Do not interpret BITW rebalancing or fee accrual as pure investor demand.
Do not count XRPR's look-through ETP exposure twice.
Align each ETF flow with the exact XRP reference-price timestamp used by the source before estimating any flow/price relationship.
Run event studies with lagged flow features and strict point-in-time availability; the latest provisional row is unavailable until its actual publication/settlement timestamp.
No correlation, causal impact, predictive edge or price forecast is asserted in this artifact.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A holdings-based ETF flow series can be more transparent than an opaque third-party flow feed when each issuer snapshot and revision is retained.
hypotheses.counter: The holdings delta can still reflect non-flow changes, capture gaps and reconstruction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Using only settled, direct issuer observations may reduce look-ahead and revision bias in XRP institutional-demand features.
hypotheses.counter: Issuer publication times vary, so a settled daily row can become available after the market event window it is intended to explain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ETF flow/price divergence may contain information about absorption, hedging or secondary-market inventory.
hypotheses.counter: No causal mechanism or out-of-sample predictive edge is established; futures basis, AP hedging, OTC inventory and fund-of-fund structure may confound the relationship.
